fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_ENABLED
fields.label: Enable module
fields.text: Enable the withdrawal workflow. Disabling does not erase stored withdrawal records or settle existing claims.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_DIRECT_FUNCTION
fields.label: Direct withdrawal function
fields.text: Allow the direct withdrawal entry point. This does not waive the identity/order verification required by the workflow.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_FOOTER_LINK
fields.label: Footer link
fields.text: Show the withdrawal entry link in the storefront footer when the theme renders its hook. This is independent of the common joobox.eu attribution.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_ACCOUNT_LINK
fields.label: Customer account link
fields.text: Show the withdrawal entry point in the customer account. It does not make other customers’ orders accessible.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_ORDER_BUTTON
fields.label: Order detail button
fields.text: Show a withdrawal entry button on the relevant order page. Eligibility and verification still apply.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_MERCHANT_NAME
fields.label: Merchant name
fields.text: Legal/trading name of the merchant shown in withdrawal documents.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_MERCHANT_ADDRESS
fields.label: Merchant address
fields.text: Complete merchant postal address for documents, not automatically a return-parcel address.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_MERCHANT_ID
fields.label: Merchant registration number
fields.text: Merchant company/registration identification shown to the customer.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_MERCHANT_EMAIL
fields.label: Merchant email
fields.text: Valid merchant contact email for the withdrawal workflow.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_MERCHANT_PHONE
fields.label: Merchant phone
fields.text: Customer-facing merchant contact telephone.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_RETURN_ADDRESS
fields.label: Return address
fields.text: Complete address and instructions for returning goods. Check it is the actual receiving location.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_PRIVACY_URL
fields.label: Privacy policy URL
fields.text: Full privacy-policy URL for this shop. Link to information relevant to the withdrawal data you collect.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_MAGIC_TTL_MINUTES
fields.label: Access link lifetime (minutes)
fields.text: Time before a newly issued guest access link expires. Shorter limits reduce exposure but may expire before the email is read.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_SESSION_IDLE_MINUTES
fields.label: Session idle timeout (minutes)
fields.text: Maximum inactivity before the guest session expires. Must not exceed the absolute session lifetime.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_SESSION_MAX_MINUTES
fields.label: Absolute session lifetime (minutes)
fields.text: Maximum total guest session duration even with activity. Must be at least the idle timeout.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
fields.label: Resend cooldown (seconds)
fields.text: Minimum wait before another access email can be requested. Limits email flooding; it does not extend link validity.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_IP_15M_LIMIT
fields.label: Requests per IP / 15 minutes
fields.text: Rate limit for requests from one IP during 15 minutes. Shared household/company IPs share the limit.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_IP_DAY_LIMIT
fields.label: Requests per IP / day
fields.text: Daily per-IP request limit; must be at least the shorter-window limit.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_ORDER_HOUR_LIMIT
fields.label: Requests per order / hour
fields.text: Hourly request limit for one order, independently of the requesting IP.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_ORDER_DAY_LIMIT
fields.label: Requests per order / day
fields.text: Daily per-order request limit; must be at least the hourly limit.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_NOTE_MAX_LENGTH
fields.label: Maximum note length
fields.text: Maximum customer note length in characters. Do not request unnecessary sensitive information in the note.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_RETRY_COUNT
fields.label: Email retry count
fields.text: Number of delivery retries for the module email queue. Zero disables retries; it does not prove the first email reached the recipient.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_ATTACH_PDF
fields.label: Attach PDF
fields.text: Attach the generated withdrawal PDF to the relevant email. Off sends the email without that attachment; it does not delete the recorded withdrawal.

fields.name: JOOIM_WITHDRAWAL_REFERENCE_PREFIX
fields.label: Reference prefix
fields.text: Use 1–12 letters, numbers or hyphens for new withdrawal references. This labels new records, not the original shop order references.

fields.name: purge_confirmation
fields.label: Deletion confirmation
fields.text: Type the literal DELETE only when you intend permanent deletion of module data. Do not enter it for ordinary settings changes.

fields.name: purgeJooimWithdrawalData
fields.label: Permanently delete module data
fields.text: Irreversibly remove the module withdrawal evidence and associated data. Back up and check retention obligations first. This is a separate destructive action, not the Save button; shop orders/customers are not its deletion target.

fields.name: @save
fields.label: Save
fields.text: Save applies the current form to the selected shop; changing a switch/select alone does not save. In GA4 the save covers Measurement, Orders and Advanced together; the banner’s separate forms are saved independently.

fields.name: @updates
fields.label: Update check
fields.text: Check the latest stable GitHub release metadata. It does not download or install code. The installed version, latest version and UTC check time are different values; unavailable is not the same as up to date. Install only the release installation ZIP with its SHA256.

captions.intro: Find the same tab and setting name as in the configuration form. Each entry explains its effect, what to enter and the available choices. Change settings for one shop, then use the Save button of that section.
captions.dynamic: Depends on the shop / selected language
